cells.quote: For the accuracy, a significant main effects of both Age [F(3,327) = 8.37, p < 0.001, η2p = 0.071] and Equation type [F(2,654) = 66.59, p < 0.001, η2p = 0.169] were found, as well as their interaction [F(6,654) = 2.53, p < 0.05, η2p = 0.023]. All participants were less accurate on the C equations compared to both the A and B equations.
cells.note: Equation types were named task conditions rather than a learning-design manipulation. Participants had been taught equation rearrangement at least one year before testing.
